summary: Loafer Creek (Lake Oroville SRA): ReserveCalifornia place/grid/details + parks.ca.gov page, brochure, camp map + imagery. Keep. Rate $35 now (stored $25 from 2026-10-12). Max 40 ft motorhome / 31 ft trailer; no closure banner. Filled 14-night max, dump, water, opens 04-01 with loop-by-loop season note. Not waterfront stands (~350 m to full pool under canopy).
